name: Phase 10.6 Chat UX and Citations
description:
Implement Phase 10.6 — Chat UX, Response Formatting, and Citation Relevance.

Current state:
- RAG pipeline works
- Grounding and citation enforcement work
- Sources are grouped by document
- Confidence labels and expandable excerpts exist
- Current issue: answer formatting is not polished, markdown appears raw, and source excerpts sometimes show broad/irrelevant text instead of the exact evidence supporting the answer

Requirements:
1. Rename chat mode labels: Normal -> General Chat, RAG -> Knowledge Base, Debug -> Debug
2. General Chat behavior: no uploaded documents, no citations/sources, clean concise answers, business-user friendly default prompt
3. Knowledge Base behavior: uploaded documents only, grounding guardrails, citations, grouped source cards, fallback for unsupported answers
4. Debug mode: admin/developer mode showing retrieval internals (raw scores, chunk IDs, retrieval rank, etc.)
5. Markdown rendering: support bold, bullets, numbered lists, line breaks, inline code, simple tables
6. Improve grouped source excerpt relevance: select most relevant excerpts for user's question and answer
7. Answer-aware excerpt selection: implement select_best_excerpts_for_source() function
8. Improve excerpt cleaning: remove noisy prefixes, sentence-boundary truncation, ~200 chars default
9. Preserve backward compatibility
10. Frontend source card behavior: compact default display, expandable excerpts
11. Tests for all new functionality
12. Validation scenario with Docker components question

Deliverables:
- Files changed
- Summary of backend changes
- Summary of frontend changes
- Test results
- Confirmation that Docker rebuild is needed
- Commands to verify deployment

goal.answer: Implement professional chat UX with proper markdown rendering, improved citation relevance through answer-aware excerpt selection, and three distinct chat modes (General Chat, Knowledge Base, Debug).

criteria.answer:
Chat modes renamed: Normal→General Chat, RAG→Knowledge Base
General Chat mode does not use uploaded documents and does not show sources
Knowledge Base mode uses RAG with grounding, citations, and grouped sources
Debug mode shows retrieval internals (scores, chunk IDs, ranks, threshold, grounding decision)
Markdown renders correctly in frontend via react-markdown library
Source excerpts selected by answer-aware algorithm, sorted by relevance
Excerpt cleaning uses sentence-boundary truncation at ~200 characters
All existing tests pass plus new tests for excerpt selection and mode behavior

constraints.answer: Do not weaken grounding logic, Preserve backward compatibility for existing API responses, Do not change LLM provider or embedding provider, Do not change authentication/RBAC except hiding Debug for non-admin

phases.answer: Backend core changes, Frontend markdown and modes, Tests and validation, Docker build and validation

assumptions.answer: Frontend uses Tailwind CSS for styling; react-markdown library can be added for markdown rendering; Tests use pytest in backend; Docker Compose is used for local development

phases.name: Backend core changes
phases.goal: Implement mode enum changes, add Debug mode, update prompts, and improve excerpt selection

steps.description: Update ChatMode enum: add DEBUG, rename NORMAL/GENERAL_CHAT, RAG/KNOWLEDGE_BASE
Implement select_best_excerpts_for_source() in citations.py with answer-aware selection
Add excerpt cleaning with sentence-boundary truncation
Update group_citations_by_source to use new excerpt selection
Update ChatResponse schema to include debug metadata

phases.summary: Completed all backend core changes: updated ChatMode enum with GENERAL_CHAT/KNOWLEDGE_BASE/DEBUG, implemented answer-aware excerpt selection with select_best_excerpts_for_source(), added sentence-boundary excerpt cleaning, updated group_citations_by_source, added DebugMetadata schema, and updated answer_generator for mode-specific prompts. All 6 steps verified.

phases.name: Frontend markdown and modes
phases.goal: Add markdown rendering and update mode labels and source cards

steps.description: Install react-markdown and remark-gfm in frontend
Update mode state to include 'debug', rename labels
Replace text rendering with Markdown component
Update SourceCard for mode-specific metadata display

phases.summary: Completed all frontend changes: installed react-markdown and remark-gfm, updated mode labels to General Chat/Knowledge Base/Debug, integrated ReactMarkdown for assistant message rendering, updated SourceCard for mode-specific metadata display (debug shows scores, knowledge_base hides them), and ensured General Chat hides all sources/citations. All 5 steps verified.

phases.name: Tests and validation
phases.goal: Add tests for excerpt selection and run all tests

steps.description: Add backend tests for excerpt selection relevance
Add tests for confidence label mapping
Add tests for mode-specific response behavior
Run all backend tests and verify pass

verification.command: docker compose exec backend python -m pytest /app/tests -q 2>&1 | tail -5

phases.summary: Completed test phase with 205 tests passing. Created test_citations.py (excerpt selection, confidence mapping, cleaning), test_chat_modes.py (mode-specific behavior, legacy compatibility, admin debug restrictions). All tests pass with only deprecation warnings.

phases.name: Docker build and validation

verification.command: docker compose build backend frontend 2>&1 | tail -3
docker compose exec backend python -m pytest /app/tests -q 2>&1 | grep -E 'passed|failed|error'

phases.summary: Phase 4 complete: Docker images rebuilt with all changes, services started and healthy (backend shows healthy status), final test run confirms 205 tests pass. Deployment validation successful.
